Contributing to bayesSampleMix

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for your interest in improving bayesSampleMix. Bug reports, questions and pull requests are all welcome.

Reporting a bug

Please open an issue with a minimal reproducible example. The reprex package makes this easy. Include the output of sessionInfo() and, for sampler problems, the seed you used.

Pull requests

  1. Fork the repository and create a branch from main.
  2. Install the development dependencies: install.packages(c("devtools", "roxygen2", "testthat", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "coda")).
  3. Make your change. Documentation is generated by roxygen2: edit the #' comments in R/, then run devtools::document(). Do not edit files in man/ by hand.
  4. Add or update tests in tests/testthat/. Run devtools::test() and devtools::check() before opening the pull request.
  5. Add a bullet to the top of NEWS.md describing the change.

Sampler changes

The test file tests/testthat/test-equivalence.R checks that seeded fits reproduce the original research code draw for draw. If a change deliberately alters a sampler, keep the original behaviour available behind a mixture_control() option (as was done for m1_update) and explain the change in NEWS.md.

Code of conduct

Please note that this project is released with a Contributor Code of Conduct. By participating you agree to abide by its terms.
